title: Optional support crate: jmap-platform-push (FCM, APNs, ADM/HPK/MiPush, WNS)
description: Decision 40 (Mark 2026-11-19): delivery through FCM, APNs, WNS, ADM, Huawei Push Kit and MiPush belongs to the deploying server, not the core kit; crate-jmap also offers an optional support crate for it, like crate-jmap-web-push for Web Push. Oracle: jmap-push-platform-guide.md, jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md, jmap-vtc-ring-push-guide.md at jmap-chat-spec 120db2c; the 36 GAP rows in docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/push.md quote each MUST.
